subject: pol-dym
title: POL.DY.------PRO.TF.C.
description: Diagram in NYM-6, on the page where Braxton begins his analysis of New York City as commercial necessity and political environment for post-Ayler creativity. (C)POL-DYM (political dynamics) is crossed with PROG-TF-C (progressional transfer cycles). The diagram poses what political dynamics looks like in the New York-specific environment. Besides the main line to PROG-TF-C (the crossing), two lines leave the subject. SOC-RT-P (social reality particulars) → POL-P (political policies). (R)TM (the reality of terminology—or terms of a definition) → RE-ST (restructuralism) → MOT-DY → RT-INT-TR (reality initiative traits) → LANG-DY (language dynamics) → S-ST (source shift, progressionalism manipulation).
